author: cursor

body:
## Intent Keep the test suites added after #2433 honest: every remaining assertion should have an independent oracle and could still fail if a live path regresses. ## Why Daily leftover pass after #2434–#2445. Agents left extra regression cases, helper-echo expects, static CSS/copy pins, and the same L165 window math at every MCP layer. Those helped while verifying; they are not worth keeping. ## Summary - DELETE extra `arm()`/`reset()` double-check case (button mix already flips that state). - DELETE account-shell CSS-only case and exact `max-height` / `overflow-y` pins. - EDIT usage popover to one label-vs-panel flip; drop CSS and extra fixture sentences. - COMBINE other-account confirm-fork decide/paint/listing-id cases; hardcode `Confirm fork` instead of echoing `CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL`. - DELETE community verify tooltip copy pin (keep `git-fork` + title-name/actions order). - TRIM duplicated L165 window math from guide/repo/package-export/search layers; keep `file-anchor` + document-section line-vs-heading + thin live-path smoke. - EDIT runtime compose/refresh expects to `__kodyCreateRuntimeObjectProxy` / `export * from` instead of `createRuntimeModuleSource()` echo. - COMBINE sqlQuery cap + RETURNING drain; pin the public 1000-row contract instead of `maxStorageSqlQueryRows`. - Drop trivial `isStorageSqlReturningMutation` keyword cases and the `sealDayStepConfig` self-pin. KEEP: CrabApple Sentry filter, mailbox list/search omit-bodies flip, secret-authority forge resistance, DR catch-up cadence, seal-day enqueue workflow, `?og=` / lantern geometry (already cleaned in #2433). ## Testing - `npm run format` before commit; pre-commit oxfmt/oxlint + typecheck + migrations:check - Targeted: 12 node-unit files (51 tests) + `seal-day-run.node.test.ts` + `storage-runner.workers.test.ts` (12 tests) - `test:push` on push: node-unit 1052 files / 3435 tests; workers-unit 98 files / 371 tests ## System changes Test-only. No production behavior change. Risk: low.
System recap — composes existing primitives (low risk) **Mode:** recap · **Base:** `main` @ `77cb4dba` · **Head:** `e318c3bc` **Classification:** composes — no primitives added or changed; this PR only deletes or rewrites leftover tests. ### Primitives touched | Primitive | Group | Impact | | --- | --- | --- | | `app-ui` | surfaces | composes — drop CSS/copy pins and extra arm() case | | `community-listings` | assistant | composes — combine confirm-fork workflow | | `mcp-server` | surfaces | composes — drop duplicated file-anchor window math | | `capability-registry` | assistant | composes — thin guide/repo live-path smoke | | `package-runtime` | runtime | composes — replace helper-echo expects | | `backup-control-plane` | storage | composes — drop `sealDayStepConfig` self-pin | Unmatched: `storage-runner` tests (row-cap contract + RETURNING drain). ### Change flow Leftover tests from #2434–#2445 lose copy pins, helper echo, and extra L165 regressions. Live-path oracles stay. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Agent participant appUi as app-ui participant communityListings as community-listings participant mcpServer as mcp-server participant capabilityRegistry as capability-registry participant packageRuntime as package-runtime Agent->>appUi: drop CSS/copy pins and extra arm() case Agent->>communityListings: combine confirm-fork, hardcode Confirm fork Agent->>mcpServer: drop duplicated L165 window math Agent->>capabilityRegistry: keep thin guide/repo smoke Agent->>packageRuntime: assert proxy/reexport instead of helper echo ```
  
--- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Test-only refactors plus making two constants non-exported; no production behavior changes. > > **Overview** > This PR **tightens test suites** after earlier regression work: assertions now target live behavior instead of echoing helpers, static CSS/copy, or the same L165 window math at every layer. > > **Backup / UI:** `sealDayStepConfig` is no longer exported; the seal-day test stops asserting the step config object was passed through. Double-check drops a redundant `arm()` case; account-management and usage tests lose CSS-only pins and keep thinner oracles (e.g. usage popover: explanation only in the panel, not the label row). > > **Community install:** `CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL` is module-private; fork-confirm tests are merged and use the literal label. Community detail HTML no longer pins the verify tooltip sentence. > > **MCP / file anchors:** Guide, repo read-file, package-export detail, and guide plugin tests shed duplicated L165–L180 range and anchor field expectations; smoke checks for line vs heading anchors and “past the end” errors remain. > > **Runtime / storage:** Package-runtime compose/refresh tests assert generated source contains `__kodyCreateRuntimeObjectProxy` / `export * from` instead of matching `createRuntimeModuleSource()` by reference. Storage-runner worker tests **merge** row-cap truncation and RETURNING drain into one case with a local 1000-row contract; trivial `isStorageSqlReturningMutation` keyword cases are removed. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 7d595007f92f340180ebe28e97a66ee36981f301. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

#!/bin/bash
# Check that sealDayStepConfig is NOT exported from seal-day-run.ts
# and CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL is NOT exported from community-detail-install.ts
# These were exported before the PR; after the PR they should be module-private.

FAIL=0

# Check 1: sealDayStepConfig should NOT have an export statement
if grep -q 'export.*sealDayStepConfig\|export {.*sealDayStepConfig' packages/backup-control-plane/seal-day-run.ts; then
    echo "FAIL: sealDayStepConfig is still exported from seal-day-run.ts"
    FAIL=1
else
    echo "PASS: sealDayStepConfig is not exported from seal-day-run.ts"
fi

# Check 2: CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL should NOT have an export statement  
if grep -q 'export.*CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL\|export {.*CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL' packages/worker/client/routes/community-detail-install.ts; then
    echo "FAIL: CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL is still exported from community-detail-install.ts"
    FAIL=1
else
    echo "PASS: CONFIRM_FORK_LABEL is not exported from community-detail-install.ts"
fi

exit $FAIL
